Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value: BEGIN SELECT c.[CustomerID] ,c.[CompanyName] ,c.[ContactName] ,c.[ContactTitle] ,c.[Address] ,c.[City] ,c.[Region] ,c.[PostalCode] ,c.[Country] ,c.[Phone] ,c.[Fax] FROM [dbo].[Customers] c WHERE c.[rowversion] > CONVERT(ROWVERSION, @startRow) AND c.[rowversion] <= CONVERT(ROWVERSION, @endRow) END

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
BEGIN SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED SET NOCOUNT ON
SELECT DBTS = (CONVERT(BIGINT, MIN_ACTIVE_ROWVERSION()) - 1); END

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value: BEGIN SELECT e.[EmployeeID] ,e.[LastName] ,e.[FirstName] ,[FullName] = e.[FirstName] + N' ' + e.[LastName] ,e.[Title] ,e.[TitleOfCourtesy] ,[BirthDate] = CONVERT(DATE, e.[BirthDate]) ,[HireDate] = CONVERT(DATE, e.[HireDate]) ,e.[City] ,e.[Region] ,e.[Country] ,e.[ReportsTo] ,[SupervisorName] = s.[FirstName] + N' ' + s.[LastName] FROM [dbo].[Employees] e LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Employees] s ON e.[ReportsTo] = s.[EmployeeID] WHERE (e.[rowversion] > CONVERT(ROWVERSION, @startRow) AND e.[rowversion] <= CONVERT(ROWVERSION, @endRow)) OR (s.[rowversion] > CONVERT(ROWVERSION, @startRow) AND s.[rowversion] <= CONVERT(ROWVERSION, @endRow)) END

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value: BEGIN SELECT od.[OrderID] ,od.[ProductID] ,o.[CustomerID] ,o.[EmployeeID] ,o.[ShipVia] ,[OrderDate] = CONVERT(DATE, o.[OrderDate]) ,[RequiredDate] = CONVERT(DATE, o.[RequiredDate]) ,[ShippedDate] = CONVERT(DATE, o.[ShippedDate]) ,[ShipCity] = ISNULL(o.[ShipCity], N'Unknown') ,[ShipRegion] = ISNULL(o.[ShipRegion], N'Unknown') ,[ShipCountry] = ISNULL(o.[ShipCountry], N'Unknown') ,[ShipPostalCode] = ISNULL(o.[ShipPostalCode], N'Unknown') ,[UnitPrice] = CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2), od.[UnitPrice]) ,od.[Quantity] ,[Discount] = CONVERT(DECIMAL(5,4), od.[Discount]) ,[AllocatedFreight] = CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2), ISNULL(o.[Freight], 0) * (od.[UnitPrice] * od.[Quantity] * (1 - od.[Discount])) / NULLIF(SUM(od.[UnitPrice] * od.[Quantity] * (1 - od.[Discount])) OVER (PARTITION BY od.[OrderID]), 0)) ,[DaysToShip] = DATEDIFF(DAY, o.[OrderDate], o.[ShippedDate]) ,[DaysLate] = DATEDIFF(DAY, o.[RequiredDate], o.[ShippedDate]) FROM [dbo].[OrderDetails] od INNER JOIN [dbo].[Orders] o ON od.[OrderID] = o.[OrderID] WHERE (od.[rowversion] > CONVERT(ROWVERSION, @startRow) AND od.[rowversion] <= CONVERT(ROWVERSION, @endRow)) OR (o.[rowversion] > CONVERT(ROWVERSION, @startRow) AND o.[rowversion] <= CONVERT(ROWVERSION, @endRow)) END

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value: BEGIN SELECT p.[ProductID] ,p.[ProductName] ,p.[QuantityPerUnit] ,[CurrentListPrice] = CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2), p.[UnitPrice]) ,p.[Discontinued] ,p.[CategoryID] ,c.[CategoryName] ,[CategoryDescription] = c.[Description] ,p.[SupplierID] ,[SupplierCompanyName] = s.[CompanyName] ,[SupplierContactName] = s.[ContactName] ,[SupplierCity] = s.[City] ,[SupplierCountry] = s.[Country] FROM [dbo].[Products] p LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Categories] c ON p.[CategoryID] = c.[CategoryID] LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Suppliers] s ON p.[SupplierID] = s.[SupplierID] WHERE (p.[rowversion] > CONVERT(ROWVERSION, @startRow) AND p.[rowversion] <= CONVERT(ROWVERSION, @endRow)) OR (c.[rowversion] > CONVERT(ROWVERSION, @startRow) AND c.[rowversion] <= CONVERT(ROWVERSION, @endRow)) OR (s.[rowversion] > CONVERT(ROWVERSION, @startRow) AND s.[rowversion] <= CONVERT(ROWVERSION, @endRow)) END

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value: BEGIN SELECT DISTINCT [ShipCity] = ISNULL(o.[ShipCity], N'Unknown') ,[ShipRegion] = ISNULL(o.[ShipRegion], N'Unknown') ,[ShipCountry] = ISNULL(o.[ShipCountry], N'Unknown') ,[ShipPostalCode] = ISNULL(o.[ShipPostalCode], N'Unknown') FROM [dbo].[Orders] o WHERE o.[rowversion] > CONVERT(ROWVERSION, @startRow) AND o.[rowversion] <= CONVERT(ROWVERSION, @endRow) END

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value: BEGIN SELECT sh.[ShipperID] ,sh.[CompanyName] ,sh.[Phone] FROM [dbo].[Shippers] sh WHERE sh.[rowversion] > CONVERT(ROWVERSION, @startRow) AND sh.[rowversion] <= CONVERT(ROWVERSION, @endRow) END
